verdict.rationale: Exa is explicitly built for LLM/RAG use, offering token-efficient content extraction (10x token efficient, recommended 4000-char extracts), structured JSON output schemas, domain filtering, and an 'answer' API returning direct results usable as context; docs and SDK confirm agentic/RAG-oriented design. Community feedback is largely positive on search quality for LLM use, though some note relevance gaps in niche queries.
